purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/レセプト) system - patient registration screen editing and SPA initial setup subprogram
purpose.summary: ORCSP02 is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system handling patient registration screen editing and SPA (screen parameter area) initialization. It processes INIT and GMN operations, retrieving system management info, insurance/public expense combinations, and patient information from a database via ORCMCPSUB calls. It manages parameter table records and linkage areas for the patient registration subsystem.

notable_features: 49 COPY statements for modular copybook-based architecture
60 CALL statements primarily to ORCMCPSUB database access layer
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (Screen Parameter Area) parameters
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCMCPSUB DB abstraction
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded text appearing as mojibake. This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 167783 bytes (3754 lines total). The program is a subprogram (called component) not a standalone batch program. No COMP-3 usage despite being a financial/billing system - likely uses display numerics throughout.
